standard.summary: Threshold 模式的阈值系数 (threshold = 批次平均 loss × 本值)。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The threshold coefficient for threshold mode (threshold = the batch's mean loss x this value).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: Threshold 模式的阈值系数 (threshold = mean_loss × multiplier)。

advanced_en.principle: Threshold coefficient for threshold mode (threshold = mean_loss × multiplier).
